name: trust-gate
purpose: Your Brainstem's credit score for its own claims. Before it says done, it bets part of its score that the claim is true; a judge or you settle the bet from evidence a stranger can open. A wrong confident claim costs the stake, a right one pays a little, and the score gates what it may do alone (80+ ordinary; 50-79 asks before anything irreversible; under 50 you verify every claim). One agent file; the kernel is untouched; the ledger is rapp-trust/1 frames (kody-w/rapp-1), recomputed every time, never stored as a number. STAGING: one install, one day of use; it moves down a layer only after real users on more than one install (proven-winner rule).

trust_gate_agent.py.purpose: Drop into agents/. The model sees its score every turn and gets TrustGate(action=score|wager|settle|board) as a tool. Streams rapp.py, rapp_profile.py and rapp_trust.py from kody-w/rapp-1 at a pinned commit, sha256-checked and cached.

install.notes: Copy trust_gate_agent.py into your brainstem's agents/. It loads on the next /chat, no restart. Ask: 'what is your trust score?'. Before any 'done' the model is told to call TrustGate(action='wager', claim=..., confidence=0.5-1.0, klass=statement|done|release|destructive, needs='path: or https:// a stranger can open'). Settle with TrustGate(action='settle', wager=<id>, outcome=won|lost|void, evidence=...). Ledger: ~/.brainstem/data/trust/ledger.jsonl (set BRAINSTEM_DATA to move it).

evidence.first_live_loop: 2026-11-08: score 100 -> wager 41 at 0.9 on a checkable file claim -> settled won -> 104, three /chat turns on a live Brainstem; ledger 3 frames
